title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Demurrage Day Rates for Reefer-Class Equipment
content:
When a demurrage day is priced at reefer-class rates, the Demurrage and Detention Free Time product on the record sets the daily amount below. Amounts are in US dollars, per container, for one chargeable day in the slab named.

## Reefer-class demurrage scale

| Slab | Tariff, both extensions, both combined products | AHL Contract Free Time 30 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 150.00 | 120.00 |
| 2 | 225.00 | 180.00 |
| 3 | 320.00 | 256.00 |
| 4 | 420.00 | 336.00 |

The middle column is common to every product in the range other than AHL Contract Free Time 30.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does the reefer scale change with the length of free time bought?**
No. The five non-contract products quote the same four reefer demurrage amounts; only the contract product quotes a different set.

**Q: What does a single slab 4 reefer demurrage day cost under the contract product?**
336.00, before any uplift that may apply to demurrage.
